kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: As Nepal identifies those killed in the floods, questions grow over China's reporting
wire.summary: One week after the deadly floods, very little is known about China's dead or missing. China's control over media and digital censorship is in stark contrast to open reporting in Nepal.

wire.title: 5 dead after crash at Miami Airport. And, Germany's far-right wins state election
wire.summary: A cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport has left five people dead and several others injured. And, Germany's far-right AfD party achieves an electoral victory in a key state election.

wire.title: 'Her body temperature was 106': How heat is killing Americans in their homes
wire.summary: Heat kills thousands of people across the U.S. every year. The risk is especially high for the millions of Americans who live in manufactured housing like mobile homes and trailers.

wire.title: The first day of school: Bells, bikes, buses and big feelings
wire.summary: Fifth graders calm school kindergartners in Los Angeles. Kids take the "bike bus" in Oklahoma. High school students take in a new high school building in Oregon.

wire.title: The copper peptide trend has gone from creams to injections — ahead of the science
wire.summary: The peptide is supposed to deliver flawless and firm skin, promote wound healing and other anti-aging effects. So what's the evidence behind GHK-Cu?

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: Five people are dead after a cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport, Trump's top envoys go to Ukraine with hopes of restarting peace talks, Germany's far-right party wins landslide victory.

wire.title: At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
wire.summary: An Amazon Prime cargo plane was landing at the airport around 2 p.m. ET on Sunday when it overran the runway, crashed and rammed into vehicles on the ground, according to FAA.

wire.title: Germany's far-right achieves an electoral breakthrough in key state election
wire.summary: Germany's populist, far-right Alternative for Germany party has declared victory in the state of Saxony-Anhalt after more than doubling its share of the vote in the first of several regional elections this fall.

wire.title: American Muslims are giving Texas barbecue a halal makeover
wire.summary: Even as anti-Muslim rhetoric rises in Texas, Muslim pitmasters are winning over diners and reshaping one of the state's most iconic culinary traditions.

wire.title: Witkoff and Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Moscow Putin meeting
wire.summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held meetings in Kyiv with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after lengthy conversations with Russian President Putin in Moscow.

wire.title: Germany's far-right AfD says 'democracy demands' parties work with them after state election win
wire.summary: The far-right party is trying to form a government in the state after falling three seats short of a majority.

wire.title: Thousands turn out in Serbia for funeral of  'Butcher of Bosnia' Ratko Mladić
wire.summary: Mladić was jailed for genocide during the 1990s Bosnian war and the EU warned Serbia not to glorify the convicted war criminal.

wire.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanese village kill 12
wire.summary: Lebanon says a recent Israeli escalation is jeopardising a US-brokered ceasefire meant to end the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah.

wire.title: Investigators begin work on why cargo plane overran Miami runway
wire.summary: Five people died and five others were injured as the Amazon plane overshot the runway after landing at Miami International Airport.

wire.title: Grindr to pay £26m to settle claims it allegedly shared users' HIV status
wire.summary: The long-running claim alleges Grindr breached UK privacy laws by sharing data with third parties.

wire.title: Nepal observes national day of mourning for victims of flash flood disaster
wire.summary: Flags flew at half mast on the 13th day since the disaster, the last day of the Hindu mourning period.
